recipe.label: Linocut

traits.medium: two-tone relief-print-looking landscape with carved silhouettes and directional hatching
traits.texture: uneven ink edges, carved white channels and restrained paper grain
traits.composition: use coherent hatch directions and strong negative space to separate trunks, foliage and the path
traits.lighting: light expressed through unprinted paper rather than gradients

review_checks: negative space separates the path from foliage
limitations: Raster art only; no cutting template, separated plates or carve-ready geometry is supplied.
Palette and fine geometry are prompt guidance and require visual review across a series.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: README style reference; intended use: One reviewed Linocut example for the Art Skill style catalog
Primary request: A lush sloping hillside garden with a thick foreground tree trunk on the left, tall slender conifers across the center-right, dense layered foliage, distant bluish hills, a small blue roof lower-center, external stairs at far left and a curving path on the right beneath a bright cloudy sky.
Style/medium: two-tone relief-print-looking landscape with carved silhouettes and directional hatching
Color palette: #F2EBDD, #253B32
Materials/textures: uneven ink edges, carved white channels and restrained paper grain
Composition/framing: use coherent hatch directions and strong negative space to separate trunks, foliage and the path; Keep landscape orientation and the original broad framing; one image, no frame or panels
Lighting/mood: light expressed through unprinted paper rather than gradients
Requested output target: 1536x1024, opaque background, png; use only supported tool controls
Avoid: real people; copyrighted characters; logos and brand marks; copied artworks; unrequested lettering
Constraints: Keep the original layered garden viewpoint, left tree trunk, tall conifer rhythm, slope, distant hills and curving path. Simplify minor details only to suit the medium. Do not add a sea, island bay, rainbow or sunset.; No added people, brands, characters, captions or signatures; Use only this source photograph as the composition reference; never mix motifs from the other photos
